_doc: Deliberate changes of Pearl's own words (b2tools/gen4_text.py bank() applies them to every user of Pearl's text: the story generator, patches). Keyed by Pearl bank and line; each pair is [old, new] in pokediamond's .gmm spelling, and the old words must be in the line. Keep this short: Pearl's text is used word for word otherwise.

_underground: 2026-10-26, the lead (notes/UNDERGROUND.md section 8): the Underground Man's first mission rewards three Underground Traps, which do not exist here (no traps, digging or Secret Bases): his line loses its 'Take these as rewards!' and no trap is given (data/pearl_script_patches.json).
_secret_bases: 2026-11-01 (notes/SECRET_BASES.md): the Digger Drill is the Explorer Kit's entry and can be used again; goods come from Veilstone and the tunnels' traders for money; no door, no friends' Flags: a Flag comes from a Hideaway visit (data/secret_bases.json).
